cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(agnocast_bridge_plugins)

if(NOT CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD)
  set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
  set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
endif()

if(CMAKE_COMPILER_IS_GNUCXX OR CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
  add_compile_options(-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
endif()

find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(rclcpp REQUIRED)
find_package(agnocastlib REQUIRED)

find_package(sensor_msgs REQUIRED)




# Plugin for sensor_msgs/msg/Imu
add_library(pubsub_bridge_plugin_sensor_msgs_msg_Imu SHARED src/pubsub_bridge_plugin_sensor_msgs_msg_Imu.cpp)
target_link_libraries(pubsub_bridge_plugin_sensor_msgs_msg_Imu agnocastlib::agnocast)
ament_target_dependencies(pubsub_bridge_plugin_sensor_msgs_msg_Imu rclcpp sensor_msgs)

install(TARGETS pubsub_bridge_plugin_sensor_msgs_msg_Imu
  DESTINATION lib/${PROJECT_NAME})





# Use precompiled headers to speed up build (requires CMake >= 3.16)
if(CMAKE_VERSION VERSION_GREATER_EQUAL "3.16")

  set_target_properties(pubsub_bridge_plugin_sensor_msgs_msg_Imu PROPERTIES DEFINE_SYMBOL "AGNOCAST_BRIDGE_PLUGIN_EXPORTS")
  target_precompile_headers(pubsub_bridge_plugin_sensor_msgs_msg_Imu PRIVATE
    <agnocast/agnocast.hpp>

    <utility>)

ament_package()
